pages.text: There was a strange envelope with a letter written in a strange style not far from the door. I was informed that $(#ff0000)I wont be able to go back until I finish work$(). They also wrote to me that $(#ff0000)the store seizes all items at the entrance$(), which means I wont be able to take anything with me, its good that I put the safe near the entrance, there will be a place to put things.
